source.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models (DreamerV3)

confidence_rationale: A strong, widely-replicated demonstration that an agent learning a compact LATENT world model and improving behaviour inside imagined (model-generated) trajectories can act effectively across 150+ domains from a single config, including long-horizon sparse-reward tasks. It is the ML analogue of REE's E2/hippocampal rollout-driven inference. Confidence held to 0.65: it is a preprint, an engineering result not a neuroscience finding, and it collapses harm/goal/residue into a single reward -- precisely the design REE rejects.
failure_signatures: A model-free reactive agent (no latent model, no imagined rollouts) fails the long-horizon/partial-information tasks Dreamer solves -- the computational analogue of 'cannot infer a route from partial evidence'.

Reward-collapse: Dreamer's single scalar reward is itself a cautionary signature for REE's insistence on separated streams; super-additive value collapse would mis-tag valence (MECH-126 valence mis-tagging).

mapping.source_claim_statement: DreamerV3 learns a latent dynamics model from interaction and trains an actor-critic purely on imagined trajectories rolled out in that latent space, achieving strong data-efficiency and generality (including first-from-scratch diamond collection in Minecraft) with fixed hyperparameters.
mapping.ree_translation: The ML existence-proof that intelligent action under partial information depends on latent prediction + imagined rollout rather than reactive mapping -- the same structure ARC-091/INF-7 attribute to E2 action-consequence prediction (MECH-033) and ARC-018 hippocampal rollouts feeding the inference layer. Supports the feasibility of building behaviour over inferred latent state, not raw observation.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Dreamer optimises a single reward and a monolithic latent; REE separates harm, goal, residue, commitment, and ethical texture and treats imagined trajectories as provenance-tagged hypotheses (INV-078). So Dreamer grounds the LATENT-MODEL-AND-IMAGINATION principle but is an architectural counter-example on stream separation and on corrigible-hypothesis provenance; do not import its reward-collapse.
mapping.source_context: Deep model-based reinforcement learning; benchmark suite of 150+ tasks (Atari, DMLab, Minecraft, continuous control); preprint (not peer-reviewed at pull time).

confidence_components.notes: Source quality lower (preprint, engineering benchmark). Mapping fidelity moderate (latent-model-imagination shared; reward-collapse divergent). Highest transfer risk in the pull -- ML->REE neuro-grounded architecture.
